render.session_progression: players (recovered), Ebm, 93 bpm, los_angeles groove, kit_dust, 24 bars

canon.method: per stem: band energy shares (kick<130Hz, snare 150-1200Hz bp@400, hats>5kHz), onset flux peak-picking, tempo via onset-envelope autocorrelation 55-200bpm folded to 60-180, 16-slot grid via best-phase quantization (+-45ms), swing from off-8th residuals; mix: chroma (FFT 8192 @22050, 55-2200Hz) + Krumhansl key correlation
canon.limits: SoundCloud transcodes decode above 0 dBFS on some rows (peak_dbfs > 0) - levels are relative evidence only; official_preview rows carry 30s windows; key estimates are single-method (Krumhansl) and cross-checks are pending; swing assumes off-8th placement

metrics.note: measured off-8th placement, not the declared nominal

tempo_verdict.note: autocorrelation locks differ per row (half/double/dotted mirrors); window 85-95 established in REFERENCE_ANALYSIS.md

key_verdict.canon_note: canon estimates are weak-correlation single-method (max r see table); no canon row may be treated as authority (EXTERNAL_RESEARCH_IS_EVIDENCE_NOT_AUTHORITY)

honest_gaps: levels are NOT compared: SoundCloud transcodes decode >0 dBFS on canon rows; levels are relative evidence only (canon limits)
centroid_hz unit is broken in the shared analyzer (values ~1e8); comparable across both sides only as a relative rank, so omitted
canon rows are 30s official previews or fan uploads, mono-transcoded; render is a 64.5s stereo mix - window difference kept
sample_flip=null: the render uses no actual Dilla sample material (sample_rights_status not_used); identity is measured-groove-and-harmony, not audio identity
